text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At dusk. Walking through the shopping 
district while munching on croquettes with 
Tamamo Cross—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's that? There's a crowd up 
ahead...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! You there, little 
Umamusume, wanna give it a spin?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Who're you callin' a little Umamusume! 
Stop treatin' me like a kindergartener!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that old guy's got guts. I'm gonna 
sweep every last prize and blow his mind.”
choice_data_list: I only have one raffle ticket, though...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: *Faceplants!* That's way too little!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, whatever. I'll just pull the top 
prize and make 'em cry their eyes out."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Alright Trainer, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grabbing the handle together, they spun 
the raffle wheel at lightning speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aw, it's just a hot spring? It ain't 
food...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Whaaaaaaaat?! A hot spring~?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: O-O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A hot spring trip~~~!?
choice_data_list:
You just said the same thing twice, didn't 
ya?

You just said the same thing twice, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"You idiot! Why are you the one playing 
the straight man?! It's supposed to be the 
other way around!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still... w-w-what am I supposed to do? 
Me, winnin' the grand prize...”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if ya give me this, I don't know what 
to do with it... I just don't know...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross had said she'd make them cry, 
but instead, she was the one on the verge 
of tears.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"A trip just for fun... When I was a kid, 
no matter how much I begged, we could 
never go on one..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What am I supposed to do with this...? 
It's way too much for me to take in..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why would I give it back?! After I went 
through the trouble of winning it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it! In that case, could you hang 
onto that hot spring trip ticket for me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That trip is an extra prize. Like in 
manzai Grand Prix competitions, if ya win, 
ya get a bonus prize, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That hot spring trip is my reward for 
conquering the Twinkle Series. Whaddya 
say?"
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll leave it to ya then! A hot 
spring, huh... Maybe my luck is finally 
turning around...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, now's no time to get carried 
away. I gotta get serious if I wanna earn 
that reward!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her heart was spurred into high gear. 
Having won the hot spring trip, Tamamo 
Cross's fighting spirit was blazing like 
boiling water.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I won the boss of the side dish 
section! With this, my belly's gonna be 
totally satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still though, that's a funny-looking 
sight. A carrot stuck right into a hamburg 
steak...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you have any idea why that carrot 
got shoved in there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason why a carrot was jammed into 
it... After thinking about it for a while, 
what came to mind was...
choice_data_list:
Because the hamburger steak joke fell 
flat?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The hamburg steak is... blurry? And the 
carrot is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dwahahaha! As if that'd happen! You're way 
funnier at playing the fool than a 
hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, laughing so much just made me even 
hungrier, darn it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's take this home with us. And 
then have dinner together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we dug into the Special Carrot 
Hamburg Steak we received together and 
enjoyed a wonderful dinner.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, these carrots... all of them? 
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heaping full... A heaping mountain of it!! 
That's one of my absolute favorite words!
choice_data_list: What other words do you like, then?
What other words do you like?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The rest is just "half-off" or "clearance 
items," stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Now then, maybe I'll send half of these 
carrots back home.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'll add a note saying 'I won it in the 
raffle!' I'm sure she'll be thrilled."
choice_data_list:
Since we're here, how about sending a 
commemorative photo too?

Since we're here, why not send a 
commemorative photo too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a commemorative photo! That sounds 
great!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's take it with big smiles! 
Trainer, line up next to me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross flashed a V-sign in front of 
the mountain of carrots. Seeing the photo, 
her younger brother and sister were 
overjoyed, shouting "So cool, so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Just one?! What a ripoff!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Still, well, whatever. When it comes to 
food, you can never have too much."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've had times where I was even more 
disappointed before. Speaking of the most 
disappointing prize ever...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid and super hungry, there 
was this time they told me, 'Here's your 
consolation prize accessoryyy!'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I thought I could somehow manage to eat 
it, but no way in hell. They could've at 
least given me cheap candy instead, I say.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's munch while we walk. I'll 
share some leaves with ya too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross gave me some leaves. Even 
just a single carrot seemed to have helped 
fill her stomach a little.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*Thud!* Hey, hold up! I'm the one who's 
about to cry here!
choice_data_list:
Even if you cry, you can always wipe away 
your tears.

Even if you cry, you can wipe those tears 
away, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you bet! Pullin' tissues is 
actually hittin' the jackpot, I'd say!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you can't fool me! In the first 
place, you wouldn't be cryin' if you 
didn't lose!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, just my rotten luck... Is my whole 
life really just gonna be like this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having lost a small test of luck, Tamamo 
Cross looked rather dejected...
